items.name: II Aquático Aclimação Open 2025

venue.name: Clube Aquático da Aclimação
venue.address: R. Dona Brígida, 375 - Vila Mariana, São Paulo - SP, 04110-061

items.information:
# Português:

Pagamento da taxa via PIX: 282.098.828-80 (CPF)

Enviar comprovante para o e-mail: helga_zavrisko@yahoo.com.br
**Envie o comprovante com o nome do competidor.**

Sócios do Clube Aquático da Aclimação terão 50% de desconto na inscrição e terão de informar no campo de comentários que são sócios e comprovar no dia da competição.
Para inscrições no local, favor levar documento que comprove sua identidade.
Inscrições no local serão aceitas com uma taxa de inscrição de R$ 35,00. Para inscrições no local, favor levar documento que comprove sua identidade. Caso todas as vagas sejam preenchidas na WCA, as inscrições no local serão suspensas de acordo com a regra [5.2.1](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Requirements.pdf) da Política de Requisitos de Competição da WCA (WCRP).
Será permitido a entrada de 1 acompanhante por competidor.

# English:

Payment with PIX method: 282.098.828-80 (CPF)

Send the payment proof to E-mail: helga_zavrisko@yahoo.com.br
**Send the proof with the competitor's name.**

Members of the Aclimação Aquatic Club will have a 50% discount on registration and will have to inform in the comments field that they are members and prove it on the day of the competition.
To register on site, please bring a document that proves your identity.
On the spot registrations will be accepted with a base registration fee of R$ 35,00. To register on the spot, please bring a document that proves your identity. If all WCA subscriptions are filled, on-site registration will be suspended according to rule [5.2.1](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Requirements.pdf) of WCA Competition Requirements Policy (WCRP).
One guest per competitor will be allowed.

items.name: Pickering Favourites Fall 2025
items.information:
[![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/)

### Registration Reminders

Since this is a "favourites" competition, **you may choose at most four (4) events**.

You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted and registration fees will not be transferred across competitions. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details.

### Mailing List

Want to know when the next competition is? Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements.

### Notice of Filming and Photography

Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.information:

- Please review the [Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/LATwistorTreat2025) tab before the competition.
- Please review the other tabs for more information on the competition.

Please note that the [schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/LATwistorTreat2025#competition-schedule) is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule. 

This competition is supported by Southern Cubing LLC. To learn more about cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/).

Make sure to check out [Louisiana Speedcubing's Facebook group](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1025679060833637) for upcoming competitions and announcements!
